notes: Main-split ABox revision of a stored fact (15 queries), kept from the earlier version and moved to the new layout. Derivability very_unlikely: stated everywhere. Related near uses functional (a town falls to one eruption); related far is stored because Vesuvius is described "near Naples" hundreds of times in passages about Pompeii. The three determinate derived queries are compositions through stored facts about Etna (on Sicily, almost constantly active, the largest active volcano in Italy); the edited relation has no other property. The indeterminate query is the background-beliefs split on Herculaneum: stored under Vesuvius by name, or as buried by the same eruption as Pompeii. Its old checks on AD 79 (one missed by Llama) are gone with the second indeterminate query. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate. Review fixes: negation now reads "Is it true that ... not ..."; the Pompeii evidence quotes the Roman cities sentence; the related-far evidence adds the description's own count (169) and Wikipedia's two adjacent paragraphs; the Herculaneum query keeps its worlds but says w2 is the weaker one.
